method: parse every module under scripts/ that dumps JSON and opens a file for writing; a reader local is a single-name Assign from a string subscript or a .get("k") call; it is dead when no Name load of that local occurs in its own function after the assignment line
limits: the names a dead local is compared against are the module's dict-literal keys; a face key read from a config file or built from a format string is outside that set
a load anywhere in the function counts as a reader, including inside a nested function: a closure use would otherwise be published as a dead line
only single-name assignments are examined; tuple unpacking (a, b = m["x"], m["y"]) and augmented writes are not reader locals
the subscript key has to be a literal string; a local key variable is not resolved
this script excludes itself and its smoke leg from the population
answer: of 1091 modules under scripts/ that publish a JSON face, 27 carry at least one local assigned from a face key and never read again (36 such lines); the same population holds 54 dead reader lines whatever the key and 18 whose dict was handed to the function. Worst present-day holders: scripts/perpetual_faces_n1.py (4), scripts/cn_core_sat_p1.py (3), scripts/cn_core_ddctl_p1.py (2)
